status: Completed; fixed node/root metadata succeeded; original Worker restored and nonce deleted. Earlier failed attempts retained.
purpose: Determine guest support for physical job-memory enforcement without SSH or container restarts
target: Cloudflare Worker cocreate, existing primary Container only
changes: Copy exact active Worker modules/bindings/settings. Serialize local DO bindings as Wrangler does and verify the identical namespace before activation. Inject only the fixed authenticated HTTP probe branch and a Container fetch override that forwards every unrelated request to super.fetch. Wait for the DO readiness marker before one fixed execution. No container rollout. Restore the original Worker version.
hypothesisRevision: The outer Worker marker proved only outer propagation. RPC methods remained unavailable even after binding repair. HTTP fetch is an existing documented interface; the internal GET marker proves the actual DO class before POST. Poll only propagation-pending responses for at most 60 attempts; never retry an execution result.
protocolVerification: native-http-protocol-test.log: synthetic authorization, readiness without execution, fixed commands, one invocation and ordinary fetch forwarding pass; not hosted native proof
authority: Fresh 256-bit nonce held outside OneDrive with restrictive file permissions; Worker receives only its SHA-256 hash. Exact POST path, 30-minute expiry, authorization in Worker and DO method, one invocation per live DO instance. No arbitrary command, request body, target instance or user selected by caller.
operation: Two fixed read-only commands as existing node/root identities using numeric 1000:1000 and 0:0, per current primary API documentation. Environment stripped by env -i; five-second OS timeout plus six-second kill; 4 KiB per output stream. No cgroup writes, candidate execution, generated input, secret or project content reads.
cost: Existing account only: two Worker version activations and at most about 12 seconds of bounded diagnostic process runtime. No new service, project, plan upgrade, image build or inference.
risks: Production Worker code temporarily changes and its Durable Object isolate may reload. The probe never starts/stops the Container or changes its image/resources. Authentication expires and then the route returns 404; restoration removes the route. Native exec may be unavailable on the current runtime.
rollback: Always restore e0caa8b5 at 100 percent after checking no unrelated Worker deployment drift; verify exact active Worker/image/resources, unauthenticated route denial and nonce file deletion. Preserve original settings/private data. Retain incomplete restoration honestly; no repeated rollout automatically.
approval: Needed for this temporary production administrator execution endpoint. Existing SSH approvals covered completed attempts, not this Worker authority change.
